content.short: Blueprint is a powerful development environment for TON, providing tools for writing, testing, and deploying contracts.
content.description: Blueprint is a comprehensive development environment and framework for the TON blockchain, inspired by tools like Hardhat and Foundry. It provides a streamlined workflow for developers to write, test, and deploy smart contracts with ease. Blueprint includes features such as contract compilation, automated testing suites, and deployment scripts, all tailored for the unique architecture of TON. By consolidating these essential development utilities, Blueprint significantly improves developer productivity and helps ensure the correctness and security of TON smart contracts.
content.meta: Master TON development with Blueprint, the ultimate project framework. Build and test on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
